name: Will of the Temur
oracle_text:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Create a token that's a copy of target permanent, except it's a 4/4 Dragon creature with flying in addition to its other types.
• Target player draws cards equal to the greatest mana value among permanents you control.
blocked_sentences: • Create a token that's a copy of target permanent, except it's a 4/4 Dragon creature with flying in addition to its other types

needs.what: copy_permanent's `except_` honouring `add_keywords` (707.9b): "except it's a 4/4 Dragon creature with flying in addition to its other types" is {"add_types": ["Creature"], "add_subtypes": ["Dragon"], "power": 4, "toughness": 4, "add_keywords": ["flying"]}, with flying written into the token's copiable values so the token flies as part of what it is and any copy of the token flies too
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's except_ is checked against loader.effects.COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (colors, types, power, toughness, add_types, add_subtypes, add_supertypes, remove_supertypes, no_mana_cost), so add_keywords is refused at load and characteristics._compute never reads keywords from copy_overrides. The 4/4, Creature and Dragon parts are expressible with power/toughness/add_types/add_subtypes. A following grant_keyword with duration permanent on the `as` binding is a layer-6 grant, not a copiable value, so a copy of the token would lack flying. become_copy's add_keywords creates no token. The rest of the card is expressible: choose_mode with up_to_if on an is_commander exists condition (as Akroma's Will / Will of the Jeskai), mode-scoped targets, and a draw whose amount is extreme_value greatest mana_value over permanents you control
